# automation-master

Purpose: local-first governance for recurring automation families.

Use `AutomationMaster` for registry, epoch budgets, preflight, reservations,
receipts, handovers, and projections. Use `RewardPolicy` for deterministic
reward calculations.

Do not use this module to schedule or launch a process. Do not store the live
SQLite database in OneDrive. Default to disabled or shadow mode. Require a
trusted deployment source, local target node, allowed target root, exact
manifest hash, and matching version before System-Gap import.

Canonical design: ARCHITECTURE.md
Security boundary: SECURITY.md
Open activation gates: TODO.md
Module manifest: ellmos-module.v2.json
